items.title: Breaking: James Valentine, beloved ABC talkback radio star, dies aged 64
items.description: The presenter and professional saxophone player is being remembered for his ability to explore the humour and oddities of daily life on the airwaves.

items.title: James Valentine swapped microphones — and found a new audience who loved him
items.description: James Valentine started his career on the stage, but it was his time behind the microphone in the studio and an interactive style that came to define him.

items.title: Live: NDIS reforms needed to secure 'enormous human rights achievement', Butler says
items.description: The overhaul will see more than 160,000 kicked off the scheme by the end of the decade, reducing its projected growth from 10 per cent a year to 2 per cent — a cut in real terms.

items.title: Disability groups say having coffee not a luxury as Butler announces NDIS cuts
items.description: An average cut of $7,000 to NDIS participant plans could hurt social supports providing the "only interaction with the outside world" for some people with disability, advocates warn, as the minister Mark Butler concedes the savings will have a material impact on participant plans.

items.title: We haven't seen budget decisions like this since Joe Hockey in 2014
items.description: As far as tough budget decisions go, we haven't seen anything on this scale since Joe Hockey's ill-fated 2014 effort.

items.title: New AI threat looms but Australian firms don't have access needed to prepare
items.description: Local banks, power providers and infrastructure firms do not have access to test their systems against a powerful new AI cybersecurity risk, Anthropic's Mythos, which has not been made public.

items.title: Live: Iran seizes two ships in the strait, calls on US to lift the blockade
items.description: Iran has said it will not reopen the Strait of Hormuz as long as the US naval blockade remains in place. Follow live.

items.title: Perhaps we're seeing Trump's tactics. Perhaps we're just seeing chaos
items.description: The countdown clock has been wiped. Perhaps it's a ploy or perhaps no-one knows what's going on, writes Middle East correspondent Matthew Doran.

items.title: Five per cent home deposit scheme fuelling price hike, report suggests
items.description: New research from property analytics firm Cotality appears to show that the Home Guarantee Scheme, intended to help first home buyers, may be worsening entry level affordability.

items.title: Pacific leaders 'totally blindsided' by declaration of fuel emergency
items.description: Confusion and some frustration remains after a key Pacific leader announced an emergency declaration had been agreed to over fuel, despite other leaders not knowing about it.

items.title: Police officer given 'golden pass' on rape allegations, victim says
items.description: When Tasmania Police misidentified Laura as a family violence perpetrator, she had no idea she'd have to fight for them to hold her abuser — a serving officer — to account. Now, she's fighting for change.

items.title: No more green bin pick-ups for some residents amid fuel uncertainty
items.description: The Upper Lachlan Shire Council says it cannot afford to be caught off-guard if a diesel shipment does not arrive, and must reserve fuel for essential services like road grading or red bin collections.

items.title: Live: ASX to open in the red
items.description: The ASX is set to open lower after a strong finish on Wall Street. The price of oil rallies above 3 per cent. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: 'Ghosted': Musicians claim gig booker owes thousands of dollars
items.description: A triple j hack investigation uncovers allegations that a booking agency has failed to pay more than 20 Australian bands and artists.

items.title: 'Not a great look': Piastri weighs in on Verstappen's F1 frustrations
items.description: Australian star Oscar Piastri speaks as Formula 1 champion Max Verstappen looks increasingly likely to walk away from the sport.

items.title: 50 years of Ramones — the album nobody bought but everyone copied
items.description: Fed up with where rock'n'roll was headed, these four New Yorkers changed the music world by playing sweet pop hooks at breakneck speed.

items.title: Residents poke fun to highlight footpath damage delay but council says there's a reason for it
items.description: Adelaide residents have decorated a large tree stump and then the hole it left in a footpath to highlight the local council's delay in removing it.

items.title: Blockchain billionaire takes Trump family’s crypto firm to court
items.description: A lawsuit alleges that World Liberty secretly installed tools to prevent the sale of Justin Sun's tokens after they became tradable in September 2025.

items.title: Australian billionaire's waste-to-energy plan labelled 'waste colonialism'
items.description: The controversial project would see waste burned to create energy in Fiji to reduce the country's reliance on fossil fuels, but locals and environmentalists are not happy.

items.title: Man shot by police, officers injured in two separate incidents in Sydney
items.description: Police officers have been injured in two separate incidents overnight in Sydney's south-west.

items.title: 70yo 'duped' into importing heroin to Sydney in fold-out camping bed jailed
items.description: Barry James Calverley's lawyers argued he was an innocent drug mule who naively and gullibly trusted a story about why he needed to bring the bed to Australia.

items.title: Kingpin's private phone calls break open Mongols' 'culture of silence'
items.description: Detectives say bikies are recruiting inside Northern Territory prisons, as a kingpin's tapped private phone calls offer a rare glimpse into the underground world of outlaw motorcycle gangs.

items.title: 'Very short on facts': Electoral Commission's bizarre communications in a crisis
items.description: As trust in their ability to effectively administer an election erodes by the day, so too seemingly does their transparency with the public.

items.title: Aussies crash in Madrid as Kasatkina sinks to new ranking low
items.description: Daria Kasatkina's difficult WTA Tour season has continued with an agonising defeat at the Madrid Open, as all four Aussie women crash out in the opening round.

items.title: Landholders band together against coal seam gas development
items.description: The Toprain Farming Collective is calling for greater protection of strategic cropping land in central Queensland, as Comet Ridge proposes an expansion and further development of the Mahalo Gas Hub.
